basicAuth.description: Basic authentication with username and password

AssessmentKey.description: The assessment key for the group the user belongs to.

AdministrativeGroupKey.description: The administrative group key for the user.

DateTimeLastUpdated.description: Date the assessment was last updated. Empty array if not yet updated.

DateTimeCompleted.description: Date the assessment was completed. Empty array if not yet completed.

Uri.description: Relative URI to retrieve this user's details.

DateTimeLastUpdated.description: Date the assessment was last updated. Empty array if not yet updated.

DateTimeCompleted.description: Date the assessment was completed. Empty array if not yet completed.

CustomData.description: Custom question responses configured for the account.

ParameterId.description: The parameter name used when passing custom data into the system.

Response.description: The user's response. Empty array if no response has been recorded.

AssessmentResults.description: Completion status for each assessment section.

IsComplete.description: Whether the section is complete. 1 = complete, 0 = incomplete.

Percent.description: Percentage score. Only present when IsComplete is 1.

Readiness.description: Readiness determination (pass, fail, question). Only present when IsComplete is 1.

Primary.description: Primary learning style(s). Only present for the LearnStyles section.

CompositeScore.description: Overall composite score. Empty array when assessment is incomplete, string score when complete.

DemographicData.description: Demographic data collected during assessment registration.

AssessmentResults.description: Scores for each completed assessment section. Empty string when no sections have been completed.

IsComplete.description: Whether the section is complete. 1 = complete, 0 = incomplete.

Readiness.description: Readiness determination. Typically 'pass' or 'fail'. Not present for all sections.

Primary.description: Primary learning style. Only present for the LearnStyles section.

Wpm.description: Words per minute. Only present for Reading and Typing sections.

Accuracy.description: Typing accuracy percentage. Only present for the Typing section.

ExtendedData.description: Detailed subscale scores. Only present for sections that support subscales.

post.summary: Provides a URL that can be used to sign the user into the system.

UseSSL.description: If this is set to true, the redirect URL will be provided with https.

IncludeSettings.description: If set to true, the custom settings supplied with the integration you are using will be applied.

RedirectToSection.description: This only applies to disaggregate mode. If supplied the user will be directed to this section of the assessment upon logging in. Use the section code (e.g. LearnStyles, LifeFactors).

RequestId.description: Unique identifier for this sign-on request.

TimeStamp.description: The date and time the sign-on request was created.

RedirectUrl.description: The URL to redirect the user to in order to sign them into the assessment.

get.summary: Provides a URL that can be used to view the report for the user.

parameters.name: ttl
parameters.description: The number of minutes the link should be valid for. Default is 2 minutes, max is 90 days.

200.description: Report link URL for the user.

EntryLink.description: The URL to access the user's report. Valid until ExpiresAt.

ExpiresAt.description: The date and time the link expires.

LinkId.description: Unique identifier for this report link.

get.summary: Returns the report for a specific user.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The type of report to be returned.

parameters.name: Format
parameters.description: The format the report should be returned in.

parameters.description: This can be a comma sep. list of SmarterMeasure user IDs.

parameters.name: ExtendedData
parameters.description: ExtendedData - If passed in, the results will include the detailed scores for the sections passed in here. This is a comma delimited list. Valid data points are LifeFactors, LearnStyles, PersonalAttributes, TechComp, TechKnowledge, Demographic.
